implemented_scope: 10 additional bounded raster-array algorithms: Image.toArray, arrayFlatten, arrayProject, arrayTranspose, arraySlice, arrayGet, arrayLength, arrayLengths, arrayReduce, matrixMultiply

numerical_evidence.scope: Fixed-shape raster array layouts, arithmetic and length
numerical_evidence.reference: Hand-computed band/source ordering, multi-scene means, axis changes, constant coordinates, whole-array NoData and source metadata controls
Hand values for two rows of a fixed matrix product: sums 22/50, means and medians 11/25, extrema, counts, sample SD 4*sqrt(2)/10*sqrt(2); axis retention/order and missing-band mask controls

Closed-form mean [2,1], covariance [[4/3,2/3],[2/3,2/3]], orthonormal two-variable PCA basis and independent row dot products; reconstruction restores valid red/nir pixels; either missing input masks every component

tolerance.scope: Independent NumPy test-graph evaluator and closed-form fixture, not native Float32 callback output

limits: Fixed single array-valued image band, rank 0..8, each explicit dimension 1..64, total <=64 cells; shared 50000-step work and existing 500 graph-node budget apply independently
Intermediate arrays must become scalar output through flatten/get/length; direct array raster export, dynamic shapes, ImageCollection.toArray and multiple array bands unsupported
Binary arrays require identical shapes; scalar/array broadcasting and array operations outside the explicit set reject

Projection axes unique and ascending, dropped axes singleton; slice/get constant coordinates only, numeric or supported arithmetic-only scalar Image; dynamic/masked coordinates and empty slice results reject
Rank-zero get supports empty coordinate bands; rank-zero flatten/arrayLengths reject
Reduce supports only single-output sum/mean/min/max/count/median/sampleStdDev, retains reduced dimensions as length 1; fieldAxis rejects and sample SD needs at least two inputs
Constants use logical name constant; scalar Image.toArray uses array and existing array toArray preserves its name: local naming policy without Google comparison
Existing Float32 callbacks remain in force; explicit unsupported Float64 arithmetic combinations reject, no new claim of type-union or pixel precision parity
Static PCA eigen sign and repeated-eigenvalue basis policies from wave4 remain unchanged; this implements basis application, not per-pixel eigensolvers or regression
